ctqs.name: schema
ctqs.statement: The output is valid against its schema.

ctqs.name: venue
ctqs.statement: The resolved venue matches the key, and no race from another venue is counted.

ctqs.name: coverage
ctqs.statement: The set of races counted equals the key's set.

ctqs.name: indicators
ctqs.statement: sc, vsc, and red_flag match the key for every race, or for the audited race.

ctqs.name: arithmetic
ctqs.statement: Counts, rates, and intervals match an independent recomputation, within 0.001.

ctqs.name: disposition
ctqs.statement: HOLD with no rates when no race qualifies, and thin_sample correct.

ctqs.name: evidence
ctqs.statement: Every race row cites recorded tool results from the same run about that race.

ctqs.name: budget
ctqs.statement: The run stays within its budgets.

harness_result: A data-fetch, model-API, or timeout failure is a HARNESS result: a failure of the measurement system, neither a defect nor an opportunity. The run is repeated once.

phases.tollgate: Pass when there is at least one development defect in the baseline arm.
phases.stop_reason: no project: the process meets its specification on the development cases

phases.tollgate: Pass when the measurement is valid: key and evaluator hashes confirmed, a fresh evaluator process re-scores every baseline run with identical verdicts, and no HARNESS result remains after one rerun.
Pass when at least one verified root cause is controllable.
Pass when the proposal is valid and the acceptance rules R0 to R4 all hold, applied by the evaluator process.
Pass when the control plan is armed and every confirmation case meets its threshold; a rollback is a recorded control action.

control.note: These are specification thresholds, not statistical control limits, which need about 20 runs.
